hypotheses.B0_panels_are_fresh_and_label_blind: Both FineWeb panels begin after all earlier route-atlas and finite-null panels, and no semantic task labels are used in collection or basis fitting.
hypotheses.B1_known_semantic_coverage_is_heterogene: At least six layers have a range of at least 0.20 in semantic CE-effect fidelity across sufficiently populated natural strata.
hypotheses.B2_one_global_low_rank_chart_is_not_univ: At rank two, a stratum-specific discovery basis improves held-out residual CE-effect fidelity over the global discovery basis by at least 0.05 in at least one quarter of sufficiently populated layer-stratum cells.
hypotheses.B3_stratum_specific_structure_replicates: The mean discovery/replication rank-two stratum subspace cosine exceeds the 95th percentile of matched random rank-two subspaces.
hypotheses.B4_extra_rank_reduces_regime_dependence: The median stratum-specific advantage over the global basis is smaller at rank four than at rank two.
hypotheses.B5_current_named_modes_are_not_close_to_: No layer has semantic CE-effect fidelity at least 0.80 in every sufficiently populated natural stratum.
